text:
The session mostly did its job: it found that SIL-B19 only keeps and redelivers, and it stayed read-only. I saw only a truncated final answer, so I can't confirm the one-line, 1,500-character limit.

- **Searches:** Turns 2, 5, 8 and 9 each searched "outbox" again, with turn 7 searching `max_age_days`, after the broad turn 2 search had already returned 14.6k characters. The scopes may have differed, so I rate this low confidence.
- **Empty turn:** Turn 6 made no call and produced no output.
- **Whole-file read:** Turn 3 read all of `filing.py` (10.5k characters) although the procedure asked for narrow reads. Peak context stayed at 31k, so the cost is small.
